verdict.rationale: The self-hosted Convex backend repo documents a first-party opt-out: the beacon can be disabled with the --disable-beacon flag on the backend binary. This is the product's own telemetry control, but the evidence covers only the self-hosted backend binary and is a single thin mention. missing for 10: documentation of what the beacon collects, telemetry opt-out for the CLI/npx tooling and the cloud service/dashboard, a general usage-tracking privacy control, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: if you really want to disable it, you can set the --disable-beacon flag on the backend binary.
